text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uggghhhhh... My eyes, my eyes are so 
itchy~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Ticket-san! Are you okay?! Ah, but 
if you scratch it, it'll swell up, so just 
bear with it, bear with it...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, hold on tight...! Sorry for scaring 
you, Yuki-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Everyone celebrated my birthday today, and 
it made me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
If I cry every time, my eyes are gonna... 
But... but I'm just so haaaappyyy...!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I-I can't say it... There's no way I can 
say it now...! I can't put Ticket-san 
through any more pain...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yuki-chan, did you call me?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, no! I'll give ya the belly warmer 
I got for your present tomorrow, so for 
today—"

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yuki-chan...!! Waaaahhh! Thank you soooo 
muuuuch!!
